## What and why

One or two sentences: what changes and which requirement or decision it serves.

## Checklist


- [ ] `sh scripts/check` passes locally. CI runs the same command.
- [ ] No commercial ROM, firmware, system card, disc image, private save or credential is added. A fixture is synthetic, carries a rights note and is listed in its manifest.
- [ ] Any support or accuracy claim names the profile and the evidence tier. A matching hash is labelled repeatability only unless an independent oracle backs it.
- [ ] A new dependency, copied helper or GitHub Action has a written justification, a licence and maintenance record, and a pinned version (an action by full commit SHA).
- [ ] No remote setting, tag, release or publication is changed by this pull request without an owner decision.
